scope.trace_semantics: Azure identity, bytes, reuse, and natural request order
scope.arrival_model: closed batch; original interarrival times are not replayed
scope.placement: seeded synthetic physical placement paired across policies
scope.no_zone_wait: safe holding-pocket delay feeds back into dispatch
scope.no_zone_bypass: candidate intermediate levels; earliest safe completion wins

virtual_assumptions.routes: direct shortest route; no holding or detour
virtual_assumptions.ownership: all same-side shuttles share pending work
virtual_assumptions.reader: exclusive physical resource selected by estimated read completion
virtual_assumptions.natural_scheduler: local owner and reader first; cross-zone help only when read-time benefit exceeds helper recovery cost
virtual_assumptions.helper_recovery: cross-zone helper returns to its home reader anchor before becoming available
virtual_assumptions.closed_scheduler: all batch tasks visible; choose the minimum estimated completion candidate
virtual_assumptions.other_costs: pick, place, load, read, unload, and platter return retained
